mapper.sql: id, email, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, verified_at, pass_token_hash, pass_expires_at, consumed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signup_email_verification ( email, code_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM signup_email_verification WHERE email = #{email} AND verified_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
